1  For Petitioner : Mr.A.V.Arun  For R1 : Mr.K.Sanjai Gandh  Government Advocat  For R2 : Mr.R.Yamuna  ORDER The petitioner seek to quash the impugned Charge Sheet in S.C.No.158 of 2021 on the file of the learned District and Sessions Court (Mahila) Madurai, which was filed for the offences under Sections 417, 376, 420, 323 and 506(i) of IPC, r/w Section 4 of Prohibition of Harassment of Woman Act, 2002.
2.The allegation in the final report is that on the promise of marriage, the petitioner had physical relationship with the defacto complainant and thereafter, refused to marry the defacto complainant,
thus,committed the aforesaid offences.

3.The learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned counsel for the defacto complainant/the second respondent would submit that the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on:
24/10/2025 03:17:14 pm ) parties have now entered into a compromise on the advise of the elders and well-wishers and both the parties have agreed that the impugned final report may be quashed.
The parties have also filed a joint compromise memo.

4.In the joint compromise memo, the defacto complainant had stated that now they are living separately and the relationship was voluntary and consensual and she has no objection to quash the proceedings against the petitioner.

5.The petitioner, namely, Mohan Raj (Aadhaar No.7706 6307 0696), and the second respondent/defacto complainant, namely, S.Jeyalakshmi (Aadhaar No.8334 3951 7382) are present before this Court in person.

They are identified by Mr.B.Kalyani, WSSI, All Women Police Station,
Thallakulam, Madurai City, Madurai.
Both the parties confirmed the compromise arrived at between them.

6.Considering the nature of the offences and the fact that the parties have arrived at a compromise,
this Court is of the view that no https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 24/10/2025 03:17:14 pm ) useful purpose would be served by keeping the impugned charge sheet pending trial.

Accordingly, the impugned charge sheet in S.C.No.158 of 2021 on the file of the learned District and Sessions Court (Mahila) Madurai, is quashed and the Criminal Original Petition stands allowed.
Consequently, the connected Criminal Miscellaneous Petitions are closed.
